note: OVERRIDES ONLY (layer L1) for the generated per-champion voxel skin, task #231. Every champion already has a complete, distinct generated look; nothing needs an entry here. This file exists so a 驗收 call-out on the 體素外觀對照表 can be answered by AUTHORING one hero rather than by special-casing the generator. Any subset of any axis may be given: palette / face / hair / outfit / motifs / preferVoxelBody. Leading '_' keeps it out of the models _index.json (it is not a model@1 doc); it is fetched by direct path, exactly like _standin-overrides.json.

axes.palette: skin hair outfitPrimary outfitSecondary metal eye accent — each '#rrggbb'

godie-h02s.note: 死亡騎士 — no 稱號, no w3x model row, and it shares champ.thorne, the same four vfx families AND hero number 91 with godie-h02z (an un-renumbered map clone). The generator separates them on id entropy alone, which is correct but arbitrary; these two are authored so the difference is INTENTIONAL.

godie-h02z.note: 不良少年 — the other half of the h02s clone pair. Deliberately the opposite silhouette: street, not armour.

godie-zombiex.note:
聖杯黑泥醬 - 喪標麥可。owner 2026-07-26：『他應該是綠色系為主』。走 L1 是刻意的 —— 這一層優先於關鍵字規則、技能特效元素與 id 雜湊三層推導，所以不必去動產生器（那條路 #264 正在改，而且改規則會波及其他角色）。
綠要讀起來像腐敗不像草地：屍綠的皮膚配暗掉的橄欖布料，金屬是鏽掉的，只有眼睛用高彩度的病黃綠當唯一的亮點 —— 一隻整身同一個綠的殭屍看起來像玩具。

godie-h01n.note: 開外掛的死神 - 黑崎一護 —— ⭐ 死霸裝就是和服形制。GH#881 之前這件上衣是**意外**來的（`#817` 為武器機制加的 `katana` tag 命中了外觀規則的「武士」正則）；那條路已經關掉，所以它改住這裡：一個**刻意的**美術決定，⛔ 不是一個機制詞彙的副作用。

godie-h01o.note: 外掛開很大的死神 - 黑崎一護（卍解態）—— 同 godie-h01n。⚠️ 兩態要一致，⛔ 否則變身當下上衣會換。

godie-osam.note: 犬妖 - 殺生丸 —— ⭐ 原作就是和服／羽織。理由同上：GH#881 把它從「武器 tag 的副作用」改成刻意指定。
